summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the primary Table 1 IC50 matrix, reconciled all linked DBAASP rows against primary source locators, preserved nonblocking database state/name conflicts, and closed the prior rework ticket with cautions rather than fabricating unavailable supplementary values.
adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair completed for the single assigned paper. The activity layer now has 16 primary XML/PDF-supported IC50 records; the database layer maps 34 linked DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows with conflict-preserving statuses; worker-6 adjudication records nonblocking gaps for unrecoverable supplementary landing-page assets.

materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF and linked database rows support the gate-changing activity/database/mechanism evidence. The remote OA package fetch had failed previously, and local supplementary assets are article landing HTML rather than data files; those nonblocking limits are recorded.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows now map to Table 1 activity records or article metadata. Source conflicts are preserved for P1/Moronecidin synonym and Cu2+-state omissions rather than hidden.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Table 1 supplies 16 source-supported cancer-cell IC50 rows with values, units, confidence ranges, targets, assay context, and locators. No database-only row is promoted to primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded to source-located cellular localization, SPR/EIS, neutron reflectometry/diffraction, and lipid-oxidation assays; cell viability is treated as phenotypic support, not sole mechanism proof.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major issue remains. Unrecoverable supplementary exact values are nonblocking because the main XML/PDF contains the gate-changing activity table and mechanism locators.

closed_rework_targets.closure_reason: Worker-2 recovered supported activity rows, worker-4 reconciled/preserved database conflicts, and worker-6 completed source-reviewed adjudication with nonblocking material-gap cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP names Piscidin 1, Moronecidin; primary source supports P1 sequence/activity but did not show the Moronecidin synonym in local XML/PDF text.
Primary Table 1 distinguishes apo and Cu2+-bound forms; linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows identify sequence records and values but not the Cu2+ complexation state.
Local supplementary .bin files are Nature article landing HTML. Exact supplementary figure values were not fabricated; main XML/PDF Table 1 and figures support publication-grade core rows.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: All ten local supplementary .bin assets identify as Nature HTML article landing documents with duplicate article links, not recoverable spreadsheet/PDF/image supplementary data; no structured supplementary tables were present in the packet.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Exact values from supplementary figures such as normal-cell MRC-5 or 48 h curves cannot be extracted locally; main text/XML Table 1 supplies the gate-changing IC50 rows.
